title: Cipher manuscript (Voynich manuscript)

evidence: The supplied image shows foliation 84 in the upper-right margin.
The Yale manifest item at index 152 has Image Label 84r and Image ID 1006226.
The supplied image matches the Yale 84r page layout: upper scalloped border, long upper scene, central text block, middle scene, lower-left figure group, and winding blue-green line.
The Yale 84v image has a different layout with blue circular scenes on the right side.
identification.interpretation_boundary: The folio side is verified by comparison with Yale's labelled page image. The script remains unidentified and undeciphered.
